notes:
Inbound SMB lead — signed up via self-serve on the hosted API. Primary product: support-agent + knowledge base retrieval. Wants low lift POC; prefers public cloud (GCP us-central).

Key technical/selection questions observed during discovery:
- Evaluating Mistral (7B/7B-v0) for cost-sensitive baseline vs Llama variants for higher QA. Also asked about Qwen variants for conversational quality and multilingual support.
- Wants concrete tradeoffs: sample-completion-quality delta (Mistral 7B -> Llama-2-13b-chat -> Qwen-14B) vs token cost, and recommended routing/fallback strategy.
- "We'd rather pay ~20% more for fewer hallucinations" — direct quote from Head of Product (Alicia Park). Emphasis on answer accuracy for customer-facing responses.
- Throughput/latency targets: ~80-120 requests/min peak; tail latency target ~<700ms for single-turn replies. Cost sensitivity: moderate (SMB) but willing to tier up for accuracy on high-value flows.
- Embeddings: using vector search for KB retrieval; asked about precision/recall differences between open embedding models and Redwood's hosting.
- Model ops: wants advice on multi-model routing, automated fallback (cheap smaller model for drafts, high-quality model for final release), and token-level cost breakdowns.
- Security/compliance: requires SOC2 attestation, SSO (SAML), audit logs; retention policy requested: 30 days for request/response logs, PII redaction preferred.

POC ask / success metrics:
- Reduce average resolution time by 25% using Llama/Mistral model + retrieval pipeline.
- Maintain answer accuracy > 92% on 200 eval prompts (team will provide test set).
- Keep monthly cloud inference cost under $1,200 for initial phase (approx).

Stated blockers: internal budget approval window (end of month), SOC2 review scheduling, need for simple cost vs quality comparison matrix and an example integration (Node/Python snippet).

Suggested sales actions: send side-by-side matrix (latency/cost/quality) for Llama-2-7B, Llama-2-13B-chat, Mistral-7B-v0, Qwen-14B; include recommended default routing policy (prefix-based + confidence threshold); attach a one-file quickstart notebook that runs a small eval on their sample prompts; offer a short (30m) technical walkthrough with SE (Diego) to go over benchmarks.
